paragraphs.text:
You  duck  by  reflex  and  the  cat  passes  over  your  head.  Its 
huge claws bury themselves in Bernard’s chest. It lunges for 
another strike.

Bernard suffers 1D10 points of damage. You may fire once more 
at  the  cat.  If  you  have  now  inflicted  12  points  of  cumulative 
damage, you kill it and may take its head for a trophy; record the 
keyword BACKWATER. Otherwise, the cat slaughters Bernard 
and bounds away.

If Bernard survived, you may attempt First Aid to grant him 
1D3 hit points. Then, go to 613. If Bernard dies, go to 614.
